description:
Accomplished and highly experienced education counsellor with over 17 years of proven expertise in guiding students toward successful careers in MBA, Engineering, and Law. Renowned for my in-depth knowledge of the Indian higher education landscape, I have consistently enabled aspirants to secure admissions in top colleges and universities across the country. My career is built on a foundation of integrity, personalized guidance, and a passion for student success.

Leveraging nearly two decades at the forefront of academic counselling, I specialize in understanding each student’s unique aspirations, evaluating their strengths, and mapping out the optimal educational pathways—whether in management, technical, or legal fields. My hands-on approach encompasses counseling on entrance exams, application strategies, college selection, and career opportunities post-graduation.

A trusted advisor to students and families alike, I am known for delivering insightful, practical, and up-to-date advice tailored to the ever-evolving demands of MBA, Engineering, and Law education. I take pride in my ability to motivate and mentor young minds, helping them make informed decisions that align with their career ambitions and life goals.
